take_homes: Default to one agent. Split only for different access, dialect or stance, and ask whether one prompt could do it.
Handoffs between agents lose numbers, so check the seams. The audit doesn't check whether the result is true.
The risk question for IT is what the agent can reach, and risky steps should propose, not do.

monday.move: Ask the controller to try the month-end variance commentary with one agent, not several, on last month's closed data, and compare it with what was written by hand.
monday.when: After the month-end close, if IT approves
monday.stop_condition: Stop if any figure in the agent's text can't be traced to the ledger, or if it saves no time.
monday.blocker: IT has not approved the tool for finance data.

misconception.why: The module never gave me a cost or payback figure, so I still see AI as a licence. The default-to-one-agent and access points came closest, because they treat it as something you design and control. They didn't change how I see it.

one_line: Honest about when not to use several agents, but no costs and no number I could take to the board.
